notes: NEW MODE: LAST TOKE (BETA). Battle royale: one life each, everyone starts with a pistol. Open LOOT CRATES (white common, blue rare, purple epic) for better guns and full health. The NIGHTSHADE CLOUD closes in four times, and outside it you choke. Last one standing wins. Offline vs bots for now.

NEW: CREW STASH HOUSE on the leaderboard CREW tab. Every member's matches earn CREW POINTS that build your hideout: couch, crew neon, pool table, grow tent, arcade, DJ booth, penthouse. A trophy shelf fills with the crew's zombies story completions. WEEKLY CREW GOAL: 1,000 DZ and a free ELITE box each.
NEW: WATCH a friend. When a friend is in an online match, press WATCH in your friends list to spectate their match without playing. The camera follows them, JUMP switches players.
Still in from 1.2.68: THE GROW OP, PROP HUNT, THE HOTBOX, night remasters, PRESTIGE 20, REPLAY THEATRE, new hit feedback and accessibility options.
